source.name: CMCHIS empanelled hospital list — Chennai district, Multi-speciality category
source.organization: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme, Government of Tamil Nadu
source.authoritativeFor: Which hospitals are empanelled under CMCHIS. Hospital name as published, and the 'Multi' type classification. Does NOT publish address, phone, or coordinates.
source.notes: Collected 2026-08-27 by filtering the site's Chennai district list and paginating through it (published total: 201 Chennai records). This file holds only the 62 records the site classified as 'Multi' type — the subset collected that session. On 2026-08-28 a second session attempted to page through the remaining ~139 non-Multi Chennai records to expand coverage. That attempt failed: the site's pagination control (React-rendered, href set to a javascript: placeholder) did not respond to element.click(), a dispatched click event, or a trusted OS-level click via element reference — no combination advanced the page or changed the 'Showing X to Y' counter. This looks like a recent change to the site rather than anything wrong with the 62 records already held, which were captured successfully via the same technique the day before. The remaining ~139 Chennai CMCHIS records (non-Multi type) are NOT in this dataset and are a known, logged gap — not silently omitted.
